scope: Supplemental verification for admitted current TSH2 source. No hardware, new numerical algorithm, full-project closure or physical signoff.

baseline.previous_framework: Procedural SystemVerilog and Python/C++ scoreboards; no executed UVM or formal claim.
baseline.disposition_rule: New evidence supplements applicable portions. A framework name or a local proof does not automatically close an original requirement.

gates.name: Source and tool admission
gates.required: Bind exact DUT, harness, fixture and oracle bytes; tool/version/executable and UVM-library identities; file order, parameters, defines and top. Stock UVM and an actual executed formal engine are required for their respective claims. Preserve failed attempts. No silent regenerated oracle or modified DUT.

gates.name: UVM architecture and execution
gates.required: Executed UVM sequence items, sequence/sequencer-driver interaction, independent passive monitor, analysis-port scoreboard, environment/test phases and objections/report handling. Trace actual accepted DUT transfers, not sequence intent. Compile the functional DUT without SYNTHESIS. Record UVM error/fatal counts, exact completion and simulator exit.

gates.name: Meaningful UVM matrix
gates.required: Execute THR2 zero and 100000000 in dense and sparse modes with recorded seeds or distinct backpressure schedules. Check source preservation, full Y values/indices, canonical tap fields, packet bytes/order, exact finite completion and held final Y under stalls. Reuse independently qualified immutable fixtures and clearly identify that oracle reuse.

gates.name: UVM checker qualification
gates.required: Positive trace and deliberate wrong expected output must both execute. The negative run must fail at the expected scoreboard/report ID with nonzero simulator/runner outcome, not an unrelated compile failure. Missing completion or zero comparisons cannot pass. Explicit observed counters are acceptable; unsupported covergroups/code coverage are not claimed.

gates.name: Formal proof scope
gates.required: Record exact module/parameter instance, property meanings, sampling, reset handling, every assumption, frontend transformations/defines, engine/solver, mode and bound. Distinguish unbounded inductive proof from bounded absence of a counterexample. UNKNOWN, timeout, unproven induction or preprocessing-only success is not proof PASS.

gates.name: Formal non-vacuity and sensitivity
gates.required: Reachability witnesses must exercise the property antecedents and key ownership states under the same assumptions: reset release, empty/full, accepted push/pop, simultaneous requests, pointer wrap and recovery where claimed. Deliberately false property must produce an actual counterexample under those assumptions. Do not assume away operations whose rejection behavior is claimed.

gates.name: Evidence and reproducibility
gates.required: Fresh immutable output directories; commands/raw logs/exit codes/deadlines; source hashes before and after; traces or counterexamples and cover witnesses; machine-readable counts and status. Package-only checks must be labeled without simulation/proof. Public receipts use normalized artifact identities with original hashes distinct from derived bytes.

gates.name: Independent final review
gates.required: Review executed receipts, UVM observation/scoreboard separation, formal assumptions and actual proof logs, negative-control failure classes, claimed coverage and public source admission. Verify the final published source is the executed source. Publish limitations beside the result.

requirement_mapping.evidence: DUT/fixture/library admission; independent-oracle provenance reused explicitly; actual transaction comparisons and intentional scoreboard failure.
requirement_mapping.closure: Supplemental selected-profile evidence; not every reference-vector class or four-state capability.

requirement_mapping.evidence: Complete Ns1024 Y/tap/packet comparisons in four threshold/encoding combinations. Metrics only if every required exposed field is explicitly compared.
requirement_mapping.closure: Selected finite vectors and static threshold only. No full mandatory corpus, general arithmetic proof, all AC10/11 fields or full-length re-execution implied.

requirement_mapping.evidence: Observed handshake acceptance, stable held payload/identity, no loss/duplication, exact full-tail completion and explicit bounded stall schedules.
requirement_mapping.closure: Conditional finite-run progress only. Dynamic threshold commit and arbitrary stall fairness remain outside the claim.

requirement_mapping.evidence: Unchanged synchronous stream_fifo: occupancy bounds, accepted-operation accounting, pointer/order ownership, registered pop output and reset/clear semantics at each proved parameter instance.
requirement_mapping.closure: Local synchronous FIFO property evidence. P-CDC-01 is not mapped because this DUT is not an asynchronous FIFO; no fabric/platform CDC or full-core reset proof.

requirement_mapping.evidence: Only if an admitted arithmetic/mask block is actually proved: explicit signed widths, independent mathematical predicate, tie/equality/protected-bin witnesses and exact parameter scope.
requirement_mapping.closure: Optional until selected before results; no full FFT/IFFT or every-width proof inferred.

fifo_review_contract.source_mapping_correction: 2026-10-17: prior mapping of stream_fifo32x256 to PCM was incorrect. Initial files are preserved with before_source_mapping_correction suffix; see source_mapping_correction_20261017.json.

active_parameters.use: Deployed Y and spectral output FIFOs

additional_parameters.use: Additional generic stream_fifo configuration; not the deployed PCM implementation

fifo_review_contract.pcm_input_exclusion: Actual PCM FIFO is separate 12-bit pcm_mem and ownership/read pipeline inside trecap_pcm_stream_source at FIFO_DEPTH256. The stream_fifo harness does not prove that implementation.
fifo_review_contract.simultaneous_empty: Only push is accepted; the new item is not bypassed to data_o.
fifo_review_contract.simultaneous_full: Only pop is accepted; the incoming item is not accepted in the same edge.
fifo_review_contract.output: data_o is registered on accepted pop. It and RAM are not reset/cleared; compare only valid post-pop observations.
fifo_review_contract.reset_clear: Reset or clear zero pointers and occupancy; do not initialize all memory in the formal harness.
fifo_review_contract.reduced_parameters: A proof at reduced width/depth is a proof of those instances, not automatically the deployed output32x1024 configuration. Generic32x256 is additional, not deployed PCM.

inherited_limits: The complete FFT/IFFT, WOLA, exporter, TCP/HPS/MMIO system is not formally proved by a FIFO harness.
Two-state formal does not establish X/Z detection, analog metastability, CDC/RDC, STA, PVT or physical reset release.
The UVM short synthetic matrix supplements the historical full384000 runs and 58 physical epochs; it does not repeat them.
Static TSH2 threshold ownership is applicable; dynamic commits, live codec/ADC, reserved DDR ring and UDP remain excluded from this active profile.
Mandatory metrics not exposed by the active service and broader original acceptance requirements remain open or partial, not waived by new framework coverage.
No energy saving, FPGA-over-laptop advantage, generic AI speedup or production reliability claim follows from UVM/formal additions.
